original_manifest_entry.accessible_description: An ivory oath-stone rostrum carries a tall bronze bell, a forked lantern standard, and a red wax lance tablet.
A broad hide drum crowns a wet bogstone court beside a crooked silt-glass retort and reed-bound healing basin.
A white-gold observatory plinth supports a suspended mirror prism, a long focus lens, and a seven-point star compass.
A living-root arch holds a thorn-crowned seed bowl, a flowering branch loom, and a bark-carved rootway stone.
A brass-and-basalt field forge joins a riveted ash mantle, a vertical kiln flame gauge, and a three-lever console.
A salt-dark whale-bone archive holds a black glass mourning bell, a pale duel mask, and a tide-carved compass.
A stepped wet-bronze floodgate cairn carries a forked measuring staff, sealed coffer, and long wind-bent pennant.
An antlered bogstone slab, crescent hide drum, reed stakes, and low moonwax basin form an uneven vertical totem.
Three white-stone legs hold a high faceted sun prism over a seven-line brass sighting circle.
A bent living-root arch encloses a bright heartseed bowl, hanging leaf plumb, and two uneven boundary stakes.
A squat black tripod holds a heavy brass plumb bell beside a redline gauge, ore tray, and smoking calibration chimney.
A slender whale-bone frame suspends an off-center pale bell above a black mirror-water bowl and three depth cords.
A bronze storm-fork mast rises from a floodgate plinth beside a long split pennant and five hanging tally tabs.
A broad hide drum sits inside a crescent antler frame hung with chain reeds, bone clappers, and five fang tokens.
A mirrored mast carries five offset crystal vanes around an open sun ring, with unequal glass feet and one blue ribbon.
A forked living root arches around five amber seed counters beside a woven thorncloth pennant and grafting stone.
A squat black-iron gantry carries an off-center blank gauge, chain winch, five clapper plates, and a short red-black pennant.
A leaning memorial ship mast bears five shell bells, a hooked crossbar, crescent mourning sail, memory lamp, and saltglass keel base.
A charred timber dispatch arch with an ember-bronze winch, twin route lanterns, sealed relief cargo, and a low crate sled.
A bundled-reed freight raft with an antler-and-bone hoist, signal bell, chained cargo baskets, and mud skids.
A faceted lens mast over a stepped white-stone cargo dais, crystal route marker, sun disc, and angular supply cases.
A living root-cart cradle with a braided vine hoist, three seed-pod signals, leaf-woven cargo, and an amber route stone.
A black-iron rail gantry with offset pressure gauges, a riveted cargo trolley, quench tank, chain hoist, and route shutter.
A leaning driftwood tide mooring with a shell-bell mast, wakeglass buoys, rope cargo cradle, salt-sealed cases, and skiff runner.
A charred tripod carries a bronze charter quadrant and two unequal hooded plumb lanterns, forming a tall asymmetrical Embercourt survey silhouette.
A crooked reed-and-bone tripod holds a blackwater listening bowl, ragged bone vanes, and hanging peatglass beads in a low Mireclaw silhouette.
A white-stone plinth turns a clear prism below a slotted sun disc and three unequal golden sight blades in a radiant Sunvault silhouette.
A living forked root cradles a constellation seed-sphere while three braided vine sight arms branch into a wide organic Thornwake silhouette.
A squat riveted iron tripod supports a brass sight tube, unequal red pressure gauges, and a toothed azimuth ring in a heavy Brasshollow silhouette.
A crescent driftwood frame surrounds an open sextant with a shell plumb, wakeglass beads, and salt-dark rope in a mournful Veilmourn silhouette.

A tall blackened-iron ledger lectern carries an uneven vertical abacus, a sealed glowing brazier, wax-tagged rain chains, copper tally plates, and a narrow parchment desk in a distinct Embercourt silhouette.
A broad hide tally drum stands on crooked root legs beside fanned bone counting rods, woven reed baskets, peatwax cords, and dangling tokens in a low, unmistakably Mireclaw silhouette.
A tall faceted crystal balance rises from stepped sunstone with one great prism pan, stacked glass counterweights, a gold solar pivot, and an elegant asymmetric Sunvault profile.
A living bent-wood arch suspends three seedpod weights above a root-grown counting desk, thorn clasps, fruit markers, and a woven collection cradle in an organic Thornwake silhouette.
A squat brass counting wheel rests on riveted feet beneath an off-center black bell, two unequal gauges, coin chutes, a winding handle, and furnace-red controls in a heavy Brasshollow silhouette.
A crescent pale-shell frame suspends three wakeglass weights above a tide-chain abacus, salt-dark hooks, narrow counting posts, and a low ledger coffer in a haunting Veilmourn silhouette.
A squat basalt treaty vault carries a tall amber beacon-key socket, a broad rolled-writ clasp, and paired tollstone seal rings.
A low crescent bogwood hunt coffer sits beneath a giant antler arch with a hanging scent bell, reed totem, and paired tall waders.
A three-sided crystal relay suspends a circular survey lens between white-stone legs beneath a mantle-draped facet and forked pennon vane.
A round living heartwood seed-vault stands inside three walking-root arches with a bark cuirass plate, flowering standard, and compass cradle.
A broad riveted drafting vault presents an enormous redline gauge beside an upright plated-vambrace clamp and rigid split gonfalon.
A crescent ship-rib chart casket carries a broken mourning mast, an oversized prow compass, and deckboots hanging from an anchor crossbar.
An asymmetric ivory and brass road obelisk carries three signal rings, a forked lantern crown, and a white-gold oath flame.
A crescent bogstone court joins a hide drum, crooked reed retort, hanging poultice bowl, and three flood stakes.
An offset oval lens turns inside three unequal halo rails beneath a prism vane and glass calibration needles.
A living root arch supports a graft spool, thorn stake, bloom lamp, and three unequal bough forks.
A squat basalt and brass forge carries a diagonal hammer rail, riveted mantle, three clamp jaws, and a red pressure gauge.
A tilted whalebone crescent bears shroud sails, a drowned lantern mask, tide marker, and three memory chimes.
A black sluice-stone seat stands beneath an open broken brass ring beside a white ember bowl.
Unequal drowned antlers frame a bogstone seat, hide drum, reed scales, and peat lantern.
An ivory-gold seat hangs in an offset prism halo crossed by three calibration needles.
A living root seat grows beneath unequal flowering boughs, two seed lamps, and a graft spool.
A basalt and brass assay seat carries three gauges, an open clamp, and a red relief valve.
Whalebone and blackwood frame an empty tide chair beneath shroud sails, a drowned bell, and three chimes.
